notes.title: We released new game :))
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=E8p8KhdZwAk;full][/previewyoutube]

Carnival Heroes is a board game similar to Nintendo's Super Mario Party and Pummel Party.
On the main game you collect gems to buy crowns. There are many features like: chest, events, hidden gifts, items, store and others.
You get gems also by playing in 23 different action minigames each turn.
The main game has two play modes: FREE and FIXED. 
[list]
[*] In free mode you draw your play path.
[*] In fixed mode you are moving along fixed path lines, but you choose directions.
[/list]

Hurry up, it has 40% launch discount
We hope you like it!

notes.title: RENTO V7 IS LIVE
notes.content:
Rento V7 is finally here!!

We added multiple dice feature + dice configurator + 5 strategy cards. Here are the details:

[h3]I. MULTIPLE DICE[/h3]
When this game setting is on, you will be able to choose between 4 dice options before you roll.
Among the standard 1 2 3 4 5 6 die, you also can choose between [0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4] , [0, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8] and [0, 1, 5, 6, 7, 10].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29354241/e1f0885be303106f698d6feedf3d862e5ac0168b.png[/img]
As you can see, the new dice have values between 0 and 10 (including).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29354241/cb0b24f055619c50bddc6680037987e4876f98a5.png[/img]
This makes the game much more fun and allows for more strategy thinking.
The multiple dice feature is available for all game types (solo, local, online and Wi-Fi)


[h3]II. DICE CONFIGURATOR[/h3]
This is premium DLC feature that allows you to customize your dice.
You can choose how many dice can players choose from (between 2 and 5) and you can configure each die sides with numbers between 0 and 10.

However there are 2 limits:
1) Each die must have 3 even and 3 odd sides
2) The sum of all dice sides much be maximum 40

[h3]III. STRATEGY CARDS UPDATE[/h3]
We increased the number of strategy cards that each player has
Now each player has 5 strategy cards in the games instead of 3

[h3]IV. MULTIPLE BUGS ARE FIXED[/h3]
We didn't only added new features but we fixed some old annoying bugs.

All these new features are available in Steam, Android, iOS and WEB platforms.
As always this update has full controller support so you can enjoy the multiple dice and the other features with your PlayStation, Xbox or Switch controller. 
Have a good play :)

notes.title: TEAM play DLC now released
notes.content:
We are extremely happy to announce that we just released Rento TEAM play :))

Rento TEAMS will add allow you to play the game in 2 teams of 2 people , 2 teams of 3 people, 2 teams of 4 people and 4  teams of 2 people.
Teams can be played online or offline (in Pass To Play mode)
Robots are also team enabled so you can create online room and join a robot in it.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734580/Rento_TEAMS/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29354241/b4a18536c246392153a6add00e2c6b6a715cb2c4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Key differences in Team games[/h2]

[list]
[*] Money are common across teams
[*] Land properties are also common across teams
[*] If one of the team goes to jail and "jail rent" setting is OFF - the whole team does not receive rents while team member is in jail
[*] Teams are chosen by room creator
[*] Robots can join multiplayer team games
[*] When people trade across teams, they can choose which player of the team to send the offer to (if offer is rejected, player can try with a different member of the same team) 
[*] When one player bankrupts, other player(s) from this team has one more roll (so if he is before start and cross it, he will get $200 which may save him from bankrupting)
[*] Game ends when other team(s) bankrupt and all players from winning team are the winners
[/list] 

Just like the deep board, this team feature is paid only if you want to create team games.
You can join team games for free in the main Rento game (but you have to wait until you see open team games).

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734580/Rento_TEAMS/]GET IT NOW[/url]

Good luck team!

notes.title: New Strategy Cards and game options added!
notes.content:
We are extremely happy to announce that we just added 4 new game modes to the game.

[h1]=== Strategy Cards ===[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/e9e7b88ca61224441ec183c6a7b6cbf339a090d8.png[/img]

If this new game option is selected, you will have 3 strategy cards, which you can use in your favor while playing. 
Please note that these cards are only 3 and once you play them, no new cards will be given to you in the current game.

Some of the cards can interact with the other players in the game. For example, a card can bring a player of your choice to your location on the game board.
Another card can raise house prices or save you from bankrupting once.

In total we added 19 strategy cards, of which every player will get 3 random cards per game. 

[h1]=== Auction Mode ===[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/24678200cdbea3abb33b191dfee7a17511cc27f6.png[/img]

This game setting will put on auction every property on which a player lands.
This will eliminate the "luck" in the game and will make your game pure strategy and trading skills

[h1]=== Win on Rentals ===[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/c3ea282ddd31d22114bb5557e24793faaf72e0fe.png[/img]

This setting will end the game when one of the players reaches a chosen amount of rents collected.
We added new "rent" indicator which will show you how close you are from winning the game by collecting rents.

[h1]=== Win on Capital ===[/h1]

This setting will end the game when one of the players has more money than the amount chosen in the "capital win" setting

We hope you enjoy all these added features.
Have a good one.

P.S. Please let us know if you have improvement idea for some map namings, mistakes or other.

Cheers

notes.title: Rento Update v4.3.5 What's New
notes.content:
In today's update Rento 4.3.5 we added one major feature:
[h1] Cast to TV[/h1]
Rento can now be played on your TV.
In order to do that, follow this instructions:
[olist]
    [*]Install Rento to your mobile phones
    [*]Start a mobile online game with your friends or family
    [*]Connect your PC to your TV
    [*]Start Steam version on Rento and show it on your TV
    [*]On the first screen in Rento, click the "TV Cast" button and enter the code, which is displayed in your mobile in-game options menu
[/olist]

It is very easy to do, soon we will make a YouTube instructional video.
Cheers

notes.title: Thousands of players
notes.content:
Rento is a cross-platform online multiplayer business game.
We are happy to announce that we have between 15 and 20 thousand games finished every day[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/3a64335c6df4277a9069180e1b3f1cc352295db2.jpg[/img]

An average game is played by 3 or even more players.
[h1]This makes around 60 thousand players playing every day.[/h1]
Now, you are part of them.

[h1]This also means that you will never wait to find an opponent to play against.[/h1]

*** The following stats are only related to the online games. The solo games are not counted. They are much more.

Thank you!
